name: NS Smooth Scroll Back to Top
author: NsThemes

sections.description:
Want to add a back to top button to your WordPress site? Whether your pages are long articles, product catalogs, or landing pages, a back to top button gives visitors a fast, elegant way to return to the top of the page without endless scrolling — improving navigation and keeping people engaged with zero configuration and zero coding required.

Install, activate, and your back to top button is ready. It’s that simple.

Why add a smooth scroll back to top button?

On long pages, scrolling back to the menu or the top of the content can be slow and frustrating. A back to top button fixes that in one click, reduces bounce rate, and makes your site feel faster and more polished. NS Smooth Scroll Back to Top adds this feature to any WordPress theme in seconds, with full control over appearance and behavior — no code required.

Full customization, no code required

From your WordPress admin you can set:

  • Button position — choose where the back to top button appears on the page (NEW)
  • Icon or text — use a FontAwesome icon or custom text as the scroll-to-top arrow
  • Background color and background color on hover
  • Text color and text color on hover
  • Border color and border color on hover
  • Scroll speed — control how fast the smooth scroll back to top animation runs
  • The button appears only when visitors scroll down, keeping your design clean on page load

Want to use your own custom image? Upgrade to Premium.

The free version lets you choose a FontAwesome icon or text as your back to top arrow. If you’d rather use your own custom image — your logo, a branded icon, or any graphic you like — the NS Back To Top Premium (BTTA) version gives you:

  • Custom image upload — use any image as your back to top button instead of a FontAwesome icon
  • Width and height control — set the exact size of your uploaded image

Discover the Premium version →

Compatibility

We continuously test our plugins for compatibility with the most popular WordPress themes and plugins. Compatible with PHP 8.5. If you find an incompatibility with a specific plugin or theme, please let us know at report@nsthemes.com and we will look into it as quickly as possible.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire ‘ns-smooth-scroll-back-to-top’ folder to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to ‘Settings’ -> ‘NS Back To Top’ to choose position, icon, colors and scroll speed
sections.faq:
Do I need to write code to use this plugin?

No. NS Smooth Scroll Back to Top works out of the box — install, activate, and your back to top button is ready. No coding required.

Can I customize the back to top button?

Yes. From ‘Settings’ -> ‘NS Back To Top’ you can choose the button position, icon or text, background color, text color, border color (plus their hover states), and the scroll speed.

Is the back to top button always visible?

No, the button only shows when you scroll down on your site, so it never clutters the page on load.

Can I choose where the button appears on the page?

Yes, you can choose the position of the back to top button directly from the plugin settings.

Can I use an icon instead of text for the button?

Yes, you can choose to display a FontAwesome icon or custom text as the scroll-to-top arrow.

Is this plugin translation ready?

Yes, NS Smooth Scroll Back to Top is translation ready.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. NS Smooth Scroll Back to Top is lightweight and built to have minimal impact on your site’s loading time and performance.

Is WooCommerce required?

No, NS Smooth Scroll Back to Top works on any WordPress site and is compatible with most themes, with or without WooCommerce.

Can I use a custom image instead of an icon for the button?

Not in the free version, which supports FontAwesome icons or text. The Premium version (BTTA) lets you upload your own custom image and set its width and height.
